title: Attack the Timeline
claim: Independent verification layers reject adversarial timeline mutations while preserving the last trusted projection.
description: A cinematic, offline laboratory for attacking a synthetic frame chain and watching the exact verification layer reject it without replacing the last verified projection.
invariants: Every accepted frame preserves canonical payload and envelope hashes.
Every accepted append preserves sequence, predecessor, and causal continuity.
Rejected candidate bytes never replace the last verified projection.
An unmeasured detector is never represented as a passing assertion.
positive_path: Run the control to verify every detector against the healthy synthetic chain.
Confirm that the accepted chain projects the stable world at its trusted high-water mark.
failure_path: Launch any adversarial mutation and observe the exact rejecting layer, quarantined bytes, and unchanged verified projection.
